name: Rappingu ☆ Bakēshon
original_name: ラッピング☆バケーション
source: This is a game where you have cosplay sex with your lover, who has come to your apartment dressed in women’s clothing. Have fun dressing up this “boy in a girl’s outfit” (?) by stripping off their sailor uniform, putting them in sexy underwear, and sticking toys up their butt.
translation: 这是一款游戏，你可以与身着女装来到你公寓的爱人进行角色扮演性爱。脱掉他们的水手服，给他们穿上性感内衣，并将玩具粘在屁股上，为这个“穿女孩装的男孩”（？）装扮，享受乐趣。
